# Bundled React runtime — source provenance

This directory contains the exact `react.js` and `react-dom.js` vendor files supplied in the user's `onboarding` original design export ZIP. The files are reference/runtime dependencies for opening the preserved design document, not original AgentSam component source. React and ReactDOM are upstream Meta/React project software distributed under the MIT license: https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/main/LICENSE .

These bytes were imported from the provided design artifact. Do not replace or claim ownership of them as AgentSam source. The AgentSam package license applies to the new AgentSam application code; bundled third-party material retains its respective upstream licensing.
